messages:
Maya: Heads-up: planning to roll the runtime tweak and kv-cache patch at 18:00 UTC. Quick checklist below, pls ack who can be on call for the 18:00-18:30 window. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/runtime-rollout

Jonah: I can trigger and watch the canary lanes. who's doing smoke?

Priya: I'll own the smoke checklist and logs. i'll run the prometheus queries and a short trace sweep. post smoke steps pls. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks. Smoke steps (short):
- hit 3 perf endpoints with `seq_length=512` load (curl script below)
- validate 95th latency < 220ms for host-tier A
- check token error rate (0) and 5xx < 0.1%
- verify fallback path works (force fallback on one host)

Maya: curl script:```bash
for ep in /generate /chat/stream /embed; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test${ep} -d '{"input":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' &
done
wait
```

Samir: Rollback plan is ready. If we see spike in 5xx or latency > 400ms for >2 minutes across >50% of hosts, we rollback. Rollback command:```bash
# rollback to previous model/runtime image
kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=registry.redwood/release/runtime:2026-02-11 --namespace=prod && 
./scripts/wait-for-rollout.sh runtime prod 5m
```
I'll be standing by to run it but prefer auto-fallback to the compatible model first.

DeployBot: scheduled job created: rollout-job-2032109876 -> starts 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z, canary=10%, ramp=5m 

Jonah: ack. i'll trigger and patch nginx if needed. i'll also open the temporary monitoring dashboard (link in #observability).

Priya: ack. I'll run the smoke steps and post results in this thread.

Maya: final checklist before go: 
- [x] release notes published
- [x] runtime image baked and verified by CI
- [ ] DB migration? (none)
- [x] oncall + release lead assigned (Samir + Jonah)
- [x] smoke owner assigned (Priya)
- [ ] post-deploy validation window (10m) assigned

Samir: I'll monitor error budgets and have rollback PR ready. If anything, ping me @samir and i'll run the rollback.

Jonah: quick Q: if the canary looks flaky, we do 5m hold or immediate rollback?

Maya: hold for 5m and collect traces. if 5xx rate doesn't improve in that hold, manual rollback. We prefer quick fallback to compatible model variant when available.

Priya: Running initial smoke now against staging-like subset, posting results in 5m.

Priya: (5m) smoke results: all endpoints ok, p95 ~190ms, 0.0% 5xx, KV cache hit-ratio at 72%. No anomalies in traces.

Jonah: :white_check_mark: good from me to start the canary at 18:00.

Samir: :white_check_mark: I'll be on standby for rollback.

Maya: Thanks — starting rollout at 18:00 UTC. Will post canary status and handoff after 18:10.

DeployBot: rollout-job-2032109876 started at 2026-03-18T18:00:05Z. canary host set: runtime-canary-3

Maya: canary started, watch the dashboard. if you see anything, call it out in this thread first then @samir for rollback.

Jonah: watching. opening parallel trace stream.

Priya: monitoring logs and latency dashboards. so far no new 5xx.

Maya: (18:12) canary looks stable, increasing to 50% ramp. continuing to monitor for next 10m.

Samir: noted. I'll hold on rollback unless we breach thresholds.

Jonah: congrats team, will follow to full ramp and post final confirmation once all lanes hit 100%.

Maya: final: full ramp completed at 18:24, no rollback needed. closing thread; followup ticket for post-mortem perf tuning: INC-2458."
